label: Week 4
title: Understanding the Patient's Story
description: 증상의 시작과 변화, 이전 진료 경험, 과거 병력과 복용 약물을 확인하는 대화를 연습해요.
scenario: 약 6주 전부터 허리 통증이 있는 John Thompson과의 첫 상담입니다. 바쁜 업무 중 시작된 통증이 어떻게 변했는지 듣고, GP 진료와 건강 상태, 복용 약물을 확인합니다.
expressions: Can you tell me how your back pain started?
Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?
Do you have any other medical conditions, previous injuries or surgeries?
Are you taking any medication at the moment?

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Can you tell me how your back pain started?
lines.ko: 허리 통증이 어떻게 시작됐는지 말씀해 주시겠어요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: It started about six weeks ago during a busy period at work. I was sitting at my desk for long hours, but there wasn't any specific injury.
lines.ko: 약 6주 전, 일이 바빴던 시기에 시작됐어요. 책상에 오래 앉아 있었는데, 특별히 다친 적은 없어요.

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Yes, it's become more noticeable over the last few weeks.
lines.ko: 네, 지난 몇 주 동안 통증이 더 뚜렷하게 느껴지게 됐어요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: What makes it worse or better?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Sitting for too long makes it worse, but getting up and walking around helps a little.
lines.ko: 너무 오래 앉아 있으면 더 심해지는데, 일어나서 걸어 다니면 조금 도움이 돼요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?
lines.ko: 의사에게 진료를 받거나 치료를 받은 적이 있나요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: I saw my GP two weeks ago. They prescribed ibuprofen and advised me to keep moving. I haven't had any scans.
lines.ko: 2주 전에 GP에게 진료를 받았어요. 이부프로펜을 처방해 주셨고, 계속 움직이라고 하셨어요. 영상 검사는 받지 않았어요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Do you have any other medical conditions, previous injuries or surgeries?
lines.ko: 다른 질환이나 이전에 다친 곳, 수술받은 적이 있나요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: No major medical conditions or surgeries. I've occasionally had some neck stiffness.
lines.ko: 큰 질환이나 수술 경험은 없어요. 가끔 목이 뻣뻣했던 적은 있어요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Are you taking any medication at the moment?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Just ibuprofen when the pain gets worse.

source.section: WEEK 4 / DAY 2 — READING / Patient History Dialogue
